implemented_scope.summary: Scoped DirectDamageHP mode-0 HP transition for SetHP negative-delta composition.
implemented_scope.composition: SetHP -> target = ModifyValue + fp_mul(MaxHP, ModifyRatio) -> delta = target - CurrentHP -> negative delta -> DirectDamageHP(damage_kind=100, mode=0) -> TryGetLockHP -> CurrentHP source-0 write -> bounded NegativeHP source-0 write

current_hp_representation.write_path: update_source_slot(entry, 0, Y) through Generic Property Runtime 11

negative_hp_bounded_representation.read_condition: only when NegativeHP gate is true and lock overflow P > 0

lock_hp_model.selection: descending scan; skip kind < damage_kind; first accepted value selected; equal values extend best to lower index; non-equal accepted value stops scan
lock_hp_model.output_actions: records from best index to list end, forward order
lock_hp_model.lifecycle_boundary: no add/remove lifecycle API invented; records are set through a deterministic sandbox composition helper

persistent_reads: DirtyHPRatio materialized, property 7 (no-lock side / lock-hit C>=T side only)
NegativeHP materialized, property 9 (only NegativeHP gate + P > 0)
persistent_writes: CurrentHP source_index 0 = Y (always on normal mode-0 path)
NegativeHP source_index 0 = fp_add(N_old, P) (only NegativeHP gate + P > 0)
